description: A dark blue textured wool long kaftan has narrow cream and gold geometric embroidery along its open fronts, lower hem and wide cuffs. Modest brown fur trims the collar, front opening and cuffs. An ivory linen long shirt beneath has blue geometric embroidery around its split neckline and lower hem. Two decorative round metal chest clasps secure the coat. A matching woven blue and gold sash wraps the waist and hangs at one side with a fringed end. Dark trousers and tall worn brown leather boots complete the practical northern outfit. Both bare hands rest visibly at his sides.
